read.thesis: AWS grew 24% on a $142B run rate with backlog up 40% to $244B and 3.99GW added in twelve months, but capex is about $200B and AWS margin is 35%, so supply is expanding aggressively alongside peers.

utilisation.quote: we are monetizing capacity as fast as we can install it

capex.peers_comment: Management said every provider would tell you they could grow faster with more supply, and Amazon is adding capacity as fast as it can.
capex.quote: We expect to invest about $200 billion in capital expenditures across Amazon.com, Inc., but predominantly in AWS

triggers.label: Capex about $200B, mostly AWS
triggers.quote: We expect to invest about $200 billion in capital expenditures across Amazon.com, Inc., but predominantly in AWS

triggers.label: AWS backlog $244B, up 40% YoY
triggers.quote: our backlog is $244 billion. That's up 40% year over year

triggers.label: AWS growth 24%, fastest in 13 quarters
triggers.quote: AWS growth continued to accelerate to 24%, the fastest we've seen in thirteen quarters

triggers.label: Graviton up to 40% better price-performance
triggers.quote: Graviton is up to 40% more price per than leading x86 processors

guidance.quote: Q1 net sales are expected to be between $173.5 billion and $178.5 billion.
Within the North America segment, we do expect a year over year cost increase of approximately $1 billion related to Amazon LEO.
We expect to invest about $200 billion in capital expenditures across Amazon.com, Inc.

red_flags.label: Capex about $200B with AWS margin pressure
red_flags.quote: It certainly has a headwind from the investments in AI and the depreciation on that CapEx.

red_flags.label: Q1 operating income guidance range wide
red_flags.quote: Q1 operating income is expected to be between $616.5 billion and $21.5 billion.

evasions.topic: Return on invested capital timing and FCF floor
evasions.quote: So we will see how that develops over time.
